title: Optional extras and standard equipment
summary: Reviews discuss optional extras, included equipment, and whether desirable features are standard, but many fragments only mention extras without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the ability to add desirable options, the availability of good extras, and the appeal of a well-specced car.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention extras, bundled packs, or missing standard features, but the short fragments often do not make the overall sentiment explicit.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and many only reference extras or standard equipment without enough context to determine sentiment.
The topic includes both optional add-ons and comments about standard equipment, which are related but not always expressed clearly enough to separate valuation from description.
Some assigned sentiments appear counterintuitive relative to the wording, so this summary follows the provided sentiment labels and evidence rather than reclassifying fragments.
